phrases.english: to pay on time (on the day fixed)

phrases.latin: Cēterōs nummōs ad diem dictam solvam.
phrases.english: I’ll pay you the rest of the money on time.

phrases.latin: dēnumerāre alicui vīgintī dollarōs prō aliquā rē
phrases.english: to pay someone twenty dollars for something
